tagline: A leading provider of wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of Northern Trust's recurring revenues, representing over 60% of total revenues, and directly reflects the management and valuation of client assets, the core of the company's business.

kpis.name: Trust and service fees
kpis.explanation: Revenues related to management, account servicing and services for assets under management or under administration.
kpis.description: These fees increase due to favorable markets, net business growth and positive foreign exchange effects.
kpis.signal: Stable growth driven by bull markets and net business acquisition.

kpis.name: Net interest income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest earned on assets and interest paid on liabilities.
kpis.description: Growth driven by higher deposits and reduced funding costs, despite lower yields on assets.
kpis.signal: Sustained increase supported by interest rates and improved deposit cost management.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Sum of operating revenues, including fees and net interest income.
kpis.description: The decline is due to the exceptional comparison base of 2024 (Visa gain of $878M), masking solid operational performance.
kpis.signal: Slight decrease despite growth in fees, due to a high comparison base in 2024.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all charges and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income decreases due to the high comparison base in 2024 (Visa gain) and a $58.8M charge for layoffs.
kpis.signal: Decline linked to exceptional gains in 2024 and restructuring charges in 2025.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined from 32.1% in 2024 to 28.9% in 2025, impacted by $58.8M in restructuring charges.
kpis.signal: Margin compression due to restructuring charges and cost growth.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $8.74 in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total assets of $177.133 billion in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Stockholders' equity
kpis.description: Stockholders' equity extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Stockholders' equity of $12.958 billion in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.8 in the last year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.633 billion in the last year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 reported fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 36.5% in the last year.

kpis.name: Custody and fund administration fees
kpis.explanation: Revenues from custodial services and fund administration for institutional clients.
kpis.description: This key Asset Servicing segment shows stable growth since 2023.
kpis.signal: Steady growth supported by demand for administration services.

kpis.name: Securities lending revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by temporarily lending securities to other institutions.
kpis.description: Securities lending revenues resumed growth in 2025 after a decline in 2023.
kpis.signal: Rebound after a 2023 decline, driven by more favorable volumes and spreads.

risks.title: Economic and government policy conditions
risks.score_rationale: The document notes that Northern Trust's earnings are affected by general national and international economic conditions, as well as actions by governments and central banks. The intensity of language suggests significant and constant impact across all company operations.

risks.title: Increased regulation and supervision
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes an increase in the scope and intensity of regulation and supervision, particularly following the financial crisis, recent banking turbulence and technological factors. The company expects to remain subject to increased regulation and supervision, with increased sanctions and fines.

risks.title: Increased competition and market evolution
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates that Northern Trust faces intense competition from a wide range of financial institutions and service companies, including new forms of competition. Market evolution and business growth may lead to increased competition.

risks.title: Technology and cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions significant investments in technology and data. Technological factors are mentioned in the context of regulation and cyber risk management, suggesting potential risk related to their implementation and security.

risks.title: Interest rate risks
risks.score_rationale: The document references interest rate risk and foreign exchange risk in the context of the banking book. The mention of Federal Reserve policies directly affecting interest rates underscores the importance of this risk to banking revenues.

ai_positioning.summary: NTRS does not have significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the excerpts provided. Its positioning on this topic is therefore not identifiable.
